population_rules.BIOS: Populate BIOS_OPTION; omit BASE_ONLY R410; retain ALL R409. Offboard mechanical selector is included as a manual purchased part.
population_rules.RESERVE: Populate R202, D20 and C202-C205. Effective reserve capacitance and usable hold-up remain unqualified.
population_rules.BASE: Optional BIOS and reserve components are DNP; no JTAG header is purchased.
population_rules.BASE_PSRAM_DNP: Omit only U203; retain R2007 CS1 link, R2008 4.7k pullup and existing bypass capacitors. Also available with every BIOS/reserve combination; BASE remains PSRAM populated.

psram_dnp_firmware_requirements: Build or configure firmware for no external PSRAM; use internal SRAM/FIFOs for sectors and cache.
Keep GPIO47/CS1 inactive high; do not issue QMI CS1 memory accesses or enable CS autodetection.
Do not expose absent PSRAM in the MCU memory map or treat floating reads as detected RAM. Firmware qualification remains pending.
open_release_items: Carrier PCB is a design draft; procurement worksheet does not authorize fabrication or assembly release.
Obtain assembler confirmation and live sourcing for every selected MPN; blank supplier codes intentionally remain sourcing_pending.

D21 High Diode SMF5.0CA and F20/F21 Littelfuse 467 source footprints reproduce manufacturer recommended lands; verify matching native pads and assembly preview. Sustained 12-V input fault clearing/energy, fuse current derating and host flex-contact coordination require bench qualification.
Verify capacitor effective capacitance versus DC bias, temperature, tolerance and aging, especially 22 uF converter outputs and optional 100 uF reserve bank.
Qualify switcher current peaks/thermal behavior and native RP235x marked-inductor orientation after placement/routing.
Optional reserve charge resistor RC0805FR-0722RL needs pulse-overload qualification: ideal initial 1.14 W, approximately 5 mJ at 400 uF and 5 V; continuous wattage is insufficient evidence.

Complete assembly orientation/footprint and shield-clearance review; C5 module is modified and installed manually. Harwin spring contacts are SMT parts requiring an assembler-approved support fixture.
Optional BIOS requires separate mechanical/timing installation qualification, isolated stock CE, R410 removal and externally verified bank-0 preprogramming; no onboard flasher is provided.
CN503 flex, optional BIOS FPC/selector harness, power leads, mounting/insulation fixture and microSD media are separate fabrication/installation items, not guessed catalog stock parts.
JLC explicitly lists assembly support fixture requirements for Harwin S7221-45R C22445132 and Abracon ASE-50.000MHZ-LC-T C596955; confirm fixture process before assembly order release.

Confirm on lcsc.com that C112291 is Yageo RC0402FR-07220RL, and find its JLC SMT parts-library entry and Basic/Extended status, before ordering (R2044-R2048); the current identity is search-index derived.
